description: Stay informed about upcoming events with Congressman Russ Fulcher, Idaho’s conservative Republican representative. These events offer a chance to discuss key issues directly with Congressman Fulcher and stay engaged in the democratic process. Join us to help shape the future of Idaho, as Congressman Fulcher continues to champion Idaho's values in Washington, D.C. Check back regularly for event updates and opportunities to get involved.
